options.label: Four-rung, vanilla-pegged
options.tagline: 6 added technologies; everything else is vanilla.
options.blurb: Keeps vanilla's topology and its shared technologies — `manufacturies` still unlocks six industries' first rung — and extends it only where our ladder has rungs vanilla never had. Smallest tree, cheapest research, most familiar to a returning player. Its cost is paid at roadmap step 2: a shared technology cannot be rewarded to one industry.
alignHeld: intensive_agriculture: era 2 -> 1 WITHHELD — would be granted at the 1836 start (unlocks fertilizer e1)
railways: era 2 -> 1 WITHHELD — would be granted at the 1836 start (unlocks railway e1)
telephone: era 3 -> 2 WITHHELD — prerequisite would sit later (shift_work era 3, electrical_generation era 3)
percussion_cap: era 2 -> 1 WITHHELD — would be granted at the 1836 start (unlocks artillery e1, munition e1)
rifling: era 2 -> 1 WITHHELD — would be granted at the 1836 start (unlocks arms e1)
screw_frigate: era 2 -> 1 WITHHELD — would be granted at the 1836 start (unlocks port e1, shipyard e1, shipyard_steam e1)

techs.name: Alternating Current
techs.renamed: It gates electric drive in mills, brine electrolysis and electric saws — polyphase distribution, not a component. A capacitor is the Leyden jar, 1745.
techs.reEra: era 4 -> 3: ladder-era alignment — it unlocks textile e3

techs.name: Plastics
techs.reEra: era 4 -> 3: ladder-era alignment — it unlocks glass e3

techs.name: Oil Drilling
techs.renamed: It unlocks the oil rig, which is Drake 1859. The pumpjack itself is 1925 and cannot be what gates an era-3 building.

techs.name: Steam Turbine
techs.reEra: era 4 -> 3: ladder-era alignment — it unlocks power e3

techs.name: Steam Threshing
techs.renamed: Vanilla's own comment says it unlocks Steam Threshers. The bare threshing machine is Meikle, 1786, and does not belong in era 3.

techs.name: Cellulose Esters
techs.renamed: it now gates nitrocellulose lacquers as well as rayon

techs.name: Continuous-Flow Production
techs.renamed: it now gates the mechanised bakery and continuous nitration as well as the moving line

techs.name: Mechanised Bakeries
techs.renamed: It unlocks the whole automated bakery, of which the dough roller is one machine — and in our ladder it is a tier building.

techs.name: Continuous Web Processing
techs.desc: A paper machine that forms, presses and dries an unbroken web at speed, so the mill’s output stops being a count of sheets and becomes a rate.

unlocks.name: Sulfite Pulping Paper Mills (continuous web processing)

techs.name: Catalytic Synthesis
techs.desc: Promoted iron catalysts and continuous high-pressure reformers turn fixed nitrogen from a laboratory triumph into a commodity produced by the shipload.

techs.name: Spray Finishing
techs.desc: Compressed-air spray guns and nitrocellulose lacquer finish a carcase in minutes where French polish took days.

techs.name: High-Speed Diesel
techs.desc: Precision injection and welded frames take the compression-ignition engine from ships and pit-head to lorries and rail.

techs.name: Automatic Shell Filling
techs.desc: Remote filling lines meter and seat explosive charges without a hand near the shell, so output stops being bounded by nerve.

techs.name: Polyamide Synthesis
techs.desc: Condensing diamines with diacids yields a fibre spun from coal, air and water - stronger wet than dry, and wholly synthetic.
